performance.driver: Sales of $2,356.7 million in 2026 increased 20 percent from $1,966.8 million in 2025, reflecting organic sales growth of 19 percent and a favorable foreign currency exchange effect of 2 percent, partially offset by a divestiture effect of 1 percent.

Net sales increased $4.5 billion, or 7.2%, in fiscal 2026 compared to fiscal 2025, primarily driven by an increase in organic cases sold, including a favorable shift in mix of cases sold, acquisitions, including the acquisition of Cheney Bros., Inc.
Net sales for the three months ended July 3, 2026 increased 111.0% from the same period of 2025, primarily due to increased sales in China.
